data.gender_notes: Maanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Maanah means a gift from Allah, a blessing, or a treasure. The name embodies the spiritual concept of being a recipient of divine grace. The name Maanah carries the meaning “A gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maanah usually hope their child will grow to embody a gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maanah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
